Pete (sec-eng): Morning — incoming CVE intake for today. Short list:
• CVE-2026-1423 (libconn) — CVSS: 8.1, EPSS: 0.62, exploit observed in wild? yes (PoC repo). Affects internal model-serving edge: libconn v1.4.2 -> 1.4.4 fixes.
Kelsey (infra): Noted. Affected manifests: k8s DaemonSet using image `registry.redwood/edge:sha-abc123`.
Ravi (runtime): Does the runtime use `libconn` directly? I thought it was only in the metrics exporter.
Pete (sec-eng): Runtime pulls it via `proxy-agent` submodule — confirmed. Impact: remote code exec through crafted request header parsing. Exploitability: high given public exposure on our inference ingress.
sec-bot: [TRIAGE] CVE-2026-1423 added to tracker RED-ISSUE-2981. Links: https://cve.mitre.org/cgi-bin/cvename.cgi?name=CVE-2026-1423 ; EPSS score: 0.62
Marta (oncall): Can we emergency patch? What's delta to upgrade to 1.4.4?
Kelsey (infra): Upgrade path is minor; need rebuild image and canary to `edge-canary` — estimated 2-3 hours including CI and smoke tests.
Ravi (runtime): We should backport a config-based mitigation: drop header parsing for `X-*-trace` and enable strict header length cap until patch rolls.
Jordan (product): Any customer-facing risk? Do we need an advisory? Is any PII at risk?
Pete (sec-eng): No PII exfil observed in PoC; main risk is RCE. Recommend customer advisory post-mitigation per policy (notify enterprise customers 24h after mitigation).
Kelsey (infra): Plan: 1) create branch `hotfix/libconn-1.4.4` — Kelsey 2) build canary image, deploy to 5% edge — Kelsey 3) runtime config mitigation — Ravi 4) monitor crash/latency for 4h — Marta 5) full rollout if green — Kelsey
Ravi (runtime): Add firewall rule to block suspicious user agents matching `^evil-scan/` as short-term layer.
Marta (oncall): I'll add alert for spikes in 500s on edge and set PagerDuty escalation if > 50 errors/min for 5 min.
Pete (sec-eng): Prioritization: P1 (requires immediate action). Assigning owners: Kelsey, Ravi, Marta. ETA to canary: ~3h.
sec-bot: [ACTION] Assigned RED-ISSUE-2981 to @Kelsey, @Ravi, @Marta. SLA: 4h initial mitigation.
Kelsey (infra): Quick question — does Dedicated infra need separate patch window? We have a reserved cluster in us-west-2 with older images.
Pete (sec-eng): Yes — Dedicated customers: coordinate with SEs; schedule staggered rollouts and offer emergency patching. Jordan can follow up for customer comms.
Jordan (product): Will do. I'll draft email and SOC message after we confirm canary.
Marta (oncall): Starting initial smoke on staging now: `kubectl -n edge set image daemonset/edge registry.redwood/edge:sha-efg456 --record` — monitoring.
Kelsey (infra): Build started: `make build-image TARGET=edge TAG=sha-efg456`.
Ravi (runtime): If canary looks good, I'll push config change via feature flag `strict-header-checks=true`.
Pete (sec-eng): Also triaging 2 lower CVEs:
• CVE-2026-2007 (yaml-parse) — CVSS 5.3, EPSS 0.12; patched in 2.1.9; low exploit evidence.
• CVE-2025-4871 (openacct) — CVSS 7.0, EPSS 0.02; local privilege escalation chain but requires local access; lower priority.
Kelsey (infra): Add those to weekly update; not emergency.
sec-bot: [INFO] CVE-2026-2007 -> RED-ISSUE-2982, CVE-2025-4871 -> RED-ISSUE-2983
Marta (oncall): Staging canary looks stable after 22 minutes: 200s steady, no new errors.
Kelsey (infra): Promoting canary to 25% per rollout plan.
Ravi (runtime): Feature flag enabled on canary. Observability shows no header-related errors. CPU +3%.
Pete (sec-eng): Good. After 2h stable, roll to 100% and close RED-ISSUE-2981.
Jordan (product): Drafted advisory — holding until green. Will include mitigation steps and timeline.
Marta (oncall): Closing loop — I'll run postmortem checklist and update incident channel once fully rolled.
Kelsey (infra): FYI, Dedicated cluster owners pinged.
Pete (sec-eng): Great work team. Follow-ups: add test-case that fuzzes header parsing to our regression suite (owner: Ravi). Also, update our KMS usage note in runbook: rotation unaffected.
Ravi (runtime): Copy — adding test and PR.
sec-bot: [RESOLVE] RED-ISSUE-2981 marked resolved by @Kelsey at 1775004167
Pete (sec-eng): Thanks all. I'll file a short summary in `#postmortems` and tag SOC. :thumbsup:
